meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会比较当前代码与已发布的 npm 版本,列出所有还没发布的改动。它阅读实际 diff,用平实语言解释每个改动是什么、为什么重要,按发布层分类整理,标出破坏性变更,并给出各层及整体的版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当你说到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等词时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些未发布的变更
say.note: Claude 会比较代码并列出未发布的改动。

say.text: 列出当前代码和已发布版本之间的所有改动
say.note: 它会按发布层分类整理这些改动。

say.text: 按发布层生成一份更新日志
say.note: 输出分层影响矩阵和版本升级建议。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude compares HEAD with latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes, reads diffs, explains each change in plain language, groups by release layer, flags breaking changes, and recommends per-layer version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', or 'what changed'.

say_en.note: Claude compares the code and lists changes.

say_en.text: List all changes between the current code and the published version
say_en.note: It groups them by release layer.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog grouped by release layer
say_en.note: Outputs the layered impact matrix and version recommendations.
